detail.longDescription: Five big outages in six days: Microsoft 365, the FAA grounding every US flight, the NSA’s classified net, major banks, United. It looked coordinated. It wasn’t. No attack, no AI agents, just five boring failures. The scary part: nobody had to do this to us. https:// simonroses.com/2026/11/a-week- of-outages-it-was-not-an-attack-and-that-is-the-worrying-part/ # Resilience # Cybersecurity # blog # AI # AgenticAI
